label: Infinite
resolution: The classical-attributes bundle uses the infinity of unreceived subsistent being, not unlimited quantity or indeterminate matter. Infinite remains an abstract Lean predicate constrained by an explicit sufficient-condition premise; no theorem establishes quantitative infinity. INFINITE_3 (the idea-frame respect inf of TruthCore.Causality.CartesianIdeaOfInfinite) is the perfection of infinite substance that an idea of the infinite presents and that a being is in act in, formally or eminently; it is a respect of the grades frame, not a predicate of beings. No statement relates it to INFINITE_1 or INFINITE_2: b0132989 runs from GOD_4 to INFINITE_1, and the passage from INFINITE_3 to maximality in being is the explicit open bridge 'Whatever is in act in the infinite is maximal in being'. The arguments of the idea-of-the-infinite batch use INFINITE_3 only.
